usage.callShape: GET https://search.reversesandbox.com/web/search?q=<query>&count=<n>&offset=<n> (only q is required; x402 USDC, ~$0.002)
usage.outputShape: body.web.results[] each {title, url, description}; body.query.original = the query string; body.web.family_friendly = bool
quirks: Query params only (GET) — q is required; count (1-20) and offset are optional.
Output does NOT match the declared registry outputSchema. Result snippets are in the 'description' field, NOT 'content'.
Results are at body.web.results[], and the query echo is an object at body.query.original (not a plain string body.query).
x402 payment settled (paid:true) but qa-pay reported confirmed:false and txHash:null on Base — payment went through and 200 returned regardless.
usage.guide: Call GET https://search.reversesandbox.com/web/search with the search query as the ?q= query parameter (URL-encoded); optionally add &count= (1-20) and &offset= for pagination. It is an x402-paid endpoint (~$0.002 USDC on Base) — pay the 402 challenge. Read results from body.web.results[], where each item has title, url, and description (the snippet field is 'description', not 'content'). The original query is echoed at body.query.original.
